From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Connor Obrien <connor@redwood.com>

Subject: Mutual action plan & implementation timeline — Cascade Health

Hi Elena / Brian —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation I put together a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) and proposed timeline so we can align owners and confirm dates before the kickoff. Attached: MAP_v1.xlsx and the SOW (SOW_Cascade_v2.pdf).

High-level milestones (proposed):
- Kickoff & architecture review: target 2026-06-29 (owner: Redwood AE / Cascade IT)
- Provisioning (VPC, access, certs): target 2026-07-06 (owner: Cascade IT / Redwood Infra)
- SSO & Auth config: target 2026-07-09 (owner: Cascade Sec / Redwood Sec)
- Integration sprint (API + webhook): 2026-07-12 -> 2026-07-23 (owner: Cascade Eng / Redwood Impl)
- UAT & quality checks: 2026-07-26 -> 2026-07-30 (owner: Cascade Product / Redwood CS)
- Go-live (soft): 2026-08-02 (owner: Cascade Ops / Redwood Ops)

Open asks for you: please confirm (by reply or in-text edits to the attached MAP):
1) Kickoff date that works for your execs/IT — we proposed 6/29.
2) Any procurement/PO timing we should be aware of.
3) Who from your side will be the day-to-day point for integrations (name + email).

Internal note: once we have confirmed dates I'll schedule a handoff call with Marissa (CS), Connor (Implementation Lead), and the infra/security folks referenced in the SOW.

Thanks —
Sooj

--

Sooj —

Thanks for this. Quick notes from our side after an internal sync:
- Kickoff: Can we move the kickoff to 2026-07-01? Our IT lead is traveling the week of 6/29.
- Procurement: Procurement needs a final SOW + cost breakdown by EOD 2026-06-25 to hit our July purchase window — can you confirm?
- Security: We need to complete a security questionnaire before provisioning. I attached the initial set of questions we need answered (security_packet_questions.pdf). Can Redwood provide a completed version in < 5 business days?
- Weekly check-ins: prefer Friday 11am PT cadence for the implementation checkpoints.

Also: day-to-day integration owner will be me (Elena Ruiz) and engineering lead is Brian O'Neill (brian.oneill@cascadehealth.com).

If you can update the MAP with the new kickoff and procurement milestone I'll review and we can sign off.

- UAT window: 2026-08-02 -> 2026-08-06 (owner: Marissa / Cascade Product)

I'll prepare a short runbook for the sprints and drop it in Confluence. If there are timing conflicts speak up now.
